notes.title: Gabriels Worlds The Adventure no Xbox One!
notes.notes:
It is an honor and with great pride that I announce the release of "Gabriels Worlds The Adventure" on the "Xbox" family of consoles, where I had an arduous but rewarding work in porting the game to consoles.

I had to kind of tweak the game a bit for performance reasons because the "ENGINE" I use is a little old, but it all turned out well.

In this Version:

ACHIEVEMENTS
Total of 10 Totaling the 1000 G.

PRESENCE
Gamertag name exposed in the game.

STATISTICS and Leaderboards.
Stand among the Masters.

Easy to complete and fun achievements securing your Mil G easy.


Thank you all.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Gabriels Worlds The Adventure players, we are happy to bring a new Update to the game in this update:
We fixed Player collisions with enemies.
We fixed the so-called God Mode, where many times we fell into a pit with thorns and the Player didn't die and just kept taking damage forever without dying.
We corrected and modified some texts and images inside the game.
We removed the Overlay screen from the Game, as it gave a lot of problems because of the ENGINE used in the creation of the game as it is discontinued it comes to give a lot of problems, we apologize.
Some elements of POLISHING in the game were added, SOUNDS, PARTICULA.

Thanks for playing Gabriels Worlds, we're happy.

WE ASK THAT IF YOU FIND PROBLEMS IN THE GAME, PLEASE NOTIFY US, WE WILL BE HAPPY TO SOLVE AS SOON AS FIRST.

Thanks.
